outlets.name: Deutsche UNESCO-Kommission

outlets.name: KölnTourismus / cologne-tourism.com

outlets.name: Stadt Köln (offiziell)
outlets.credible: Official municipal site; authoritative for civic monuments, museums and parks.

outlets.name: Förderverein Romanische Kirchen Köln
outlets.credible: Official heritage association for Cologne's twelve great Romanesque churches; the authority on them.

outlets.name: Museen der Stadt Köln
outlets.credible: Official umbrella of the City of Cologne's museums (Ludwig, Wallraf, RGM, Schnütgen, RJM, Stadtmuseum, NS-Dok).

outlets.name: Wallraf-Richartz-Museum & Fondation Corboud
outlets.credible: Official site of Cologne's oldest museum.

outlets.name: Kolumba – Kunstmuseum des Erzbistums Köln
outlets.credible: Official archdiocesan art museum in the Zumthor building.

outlets.name: Museum für Angewandte Kunst Köln
outlets.credible: Official site of Cologne's applied-arts museum.

outlets.name: Käthe Kollwitz Museum Köln
outlets.credible: Official museum holding the world's largest Kollwitz collection.

outlets.name: Melatenfriedhof.de
outlets.credible: Reference site for Cologne's historic Melaten cemetery (hours, information).

outlets.name: Guide MICHELIN Deutschland
outlets.credible: Michelin Guide; a single starred/listed entry is sufficient ground truth for a restaurant.

outlets.name: Falstaff
outlets.credible: Major German-language food & wine guide/magazine with a Cologne restaurant coverage.

outlets.name: Der Feinschmecker
outlets.credible: National German gourmet magazine; publishes Cologne best-restaurants lists.

outlets.name: Mit Vergnügen Köln
outlets.credible: Popular Cologne city-lifestyle editorial with widely-read curated food & bar guides.

outlets.name: Geheimtipp Köln
outlets.credible: Widely-followed Cologne food & city editorial (Instagram + site).

outlets.name: Köln-Magazin
outlets.credible: Cologne city magazine with restaurant and Kneipe features.

outlets.name: koelner.de
outlets.credible: Cologne locations/venue directory with editorial descriptions.

outlets.name: t-online Köln
outlets.credible: Regional edition of the national news portal t-online; ran the readers' favourite-Brauhaus poll.

outlets.name: koeln0221.de
